name: Stendorren Fastigheter AB (publ)
summary: Stendörren Fastigheter AB (publ) operates as a real estate company. The company owns, develops, and manages warehouses, logistics, industrial premises, and office spaces primarily located in Greater Stockholm and Mälardalen. As of December 31, 2020, it had 123 properties. The company was formerly known as Header Compression Sweden Holding AB and changed its name to Stendörren Fastigheter AB (publ) in November 2014. Stendörren Fastigheter AB (publ) was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
